atlas · connect

Connect your agent in one command.

Atlas speaks MCP. Point your agent at the Atlas endpoint and sign in as yourself. It reads what you can read, and its edits come back to your team as change requests.

endpointhttps://app.atlascontext.ai/mcp/

You need an Atlas workspace first. Atlas is invite-only while we run it with pilot teams.

Book a demo
claude mcp add --transport http atlas https://app.atlascontext.ai/mcp/

Run /mcp in Claude Code and sign in.

codex mcp add atlas --url https://app.atlascontext.ai/mcp/
codex mcp login atlas

The login command opens Atlas in your browser.

.cursor/mcp.json

{ "mcpServers": { "atlas": { "url": "https://app.atlascontext.ai/mcp/" } } }

Cursor asks you to sign in the first time it connects.

code --add-mcp '{"name":"atlas","type":"http","url":"https://app.atlascontext.ai/mcp/"}'

VS Code asks you to sign in the first time an agent uses Atlas.

Settings › Connectors › Add custom connector

https://app.atlascontext.ai/mcp/

Paste the endpoint, then sign in when Claude asks.

request header

Authorization: Bearer km_live_…

Any MCP client with OAuth works. For a scheduled job with no one to sign in, a workspace admin creates an API key limited to chosen teamspaces, tables and metrics, and the job sends it in this header.

What happens when you sign in.

  1. Your agent opens Atlas in a browser. You sign in and pick a workspace.
  2. You approve access for this agent. It gets its own grant and never sees your browser session.
  3. Every call checks your current access. Lose access to a page and your agent loses it on its next call.

The tools your agent gets.

  • search_contextnavigate_contextinspect_context

    Find and read pages, skills, tables and metrics.

  • execute_query

    Run read-only SQL on your warehouse. Needs access to every table.

  • create_change_requestpropose_change_request_patchsubmit_change_request

    Propose an edit for a person to review.

  • list_change_requestsread_change_requestapprove_change_requestresolve_change_request_conflicts

    Review open changes. Approving needs your explicit consent.

  • get_mcp_guide

    Short guides the agent reads before it starts.

Admins can limit each tool to everyone, admins or owners, or turn it off.
